text: To test whether pretrained models are simply robust to label noise, the authors construct randomly perturbed labels with the same accuracy as ICM's labels and report that ICM-generated labels always achieve substantially better performance with many-shot prompting. They suspect this is because ICM labels are more aligned with the model's own understanding of the task.
title: ICM labels beat equally accurate randomly perturbed labels
